title: Configured OpenAI judge lane
description:
# Configured OpenAI judge lane

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent with OpenAI configured, I want scan to add judge findings and dimension grades (Terra by default), so I see problems heuristics miss — without the judge silently editing the finding list.

## Done when

- Project/profile config can set `judge.provider: openai` and `judge.model` (default **gpt-5.6-terra** or the documented Terra id).
- When configured and an API key is present, scan may emit extra findings and an optional `rubric` object (clarity, directness, specificity, voice, fidelity — anchored ordinals + evidence spans).
- Judge findings use `source: judge` and record `model` and `promptVersion`.
- Judge **adds** only. Always-lane findings remain even when the judge would skip them.
- Behave/unit tests inject a fake judge resolver. No `LIMATUS_TEST_*` production env hooks.
- Missing API key: always-lane still succeeds; judge lane is omitted (or a clear non-fatal notice), not a hard fail unless `--require-judge` is set.
- Other providers are rejected or ignored with a clear error if named.

## Out of scope

Bedrock, Anthropic, Google, Chinese providers. Fine-tuning a domain judge. Using Sol as default.
